title: Implement AndroidStrategy with hang-timer fallback
completion_summary: Created AndroidStrategy with hang-timer fallback and PlaybackState ref
acceptance_criteria: Internal _isPlayPending flag, _state: PlaybackState ref, and _hangTimer: number | null tracked
gesturePlay sets audio.src, calls audio.play(), catches with muted fallback then canplay fallback
nonGesturePlay sets _isPlayPending=true, audio.src=url, mutes, calls audio.play()
nonGesturePlay sets 500ms _hangTimer: if timeout fires, adds canplay listener and calls muted play()
nonGesturePlay .catch() clears _hangTimer, _isPlayPending=false, adds canplay listener, calls muted play()
